First, let us load in the TSV data:
```{r}
data <- read.table("data.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
```

Now, we can verify that the shape of the dataframe is as expected:
```{r}
print(dim(data))
print(colnames(data))
```

Finally, we can import `ggplot2` and create the violin plot, setting the "Sex" column as a factor:
```{r fig.height=4}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data, aes(x = Diagnosis, y = Age, fill = factor(Sex))) +
  geom_violin()
```
